name: Choose TOTP Disable
summary: An authenticated user with TOTP enabled chooses to disable the authenticator and is shown an explicit confirmation surface before any server mutation occurs.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated and TOTP is enabled

serverInteraction.intent: Navigate to the TOTP disable confirmation surface without changing MFA state.

postconditions.expression: TOTP remains enabled until the user explicitly confirms disable

sourceReferences.note: The direct UI runner proof is fully specified by deterministic HasTOTP setup, action:disable, the confirmation destination, and required visible finders on each supported client platform.
